candidates.selfReviewNotes: 同一孩子在春夏冬窗景前都刷牙，跨季节保持相同行为，能读出一直坚持的习惯；无文字。

visualReview.method: Each image was actually viewed by its generator, then cross-reviewed as a numbered image with target word, definition and prompt hidden; root compared observations with the exact game sense and reinspected ambiguous cases.
visualReview.primary: 同一个孩子在春天、夏天和冬天都在镜子前刷牙。
issues: 季节变化与动作重复清楚，但三个时间点并不能精确表达频率词之间的差别。
visualReview.reason: 跨季节刷牙表达长期习惯，但仍易读成经常或每天，无法清楚区分总是。

candidates.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one independent square English vocabulary illustration.
Exact target sense: word / n. / 话. Depict precisely this sense.
Scene: Close, simple scene of one person speaking quietly into a listeners ear, hand cupped beside the mouth, listener leaning attentively. A small plain speech bubble from the speakers mouth is completely blank. Visible mouth shape and listening expression convey spoken words, not singing, shouting or a telephone call.
Style: hand-painted gouache and subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper, soft natural daylight, muted green blue coral colors, clean centered composition with generous margins, legible at small card size.
Constraints: no letters, words, digits, labels, logo, watermark, borders or card UI. This is one image for one sense only, not a vocabulary collage. Convey meaning through visible subjects, actions, features and relationships.
